hook: Someone actually installed *iOS 16* on a Redmi Note 12
caption:
📲A developer manages to run iOS 16 on a Xiaomi Redmi Note 12.
A developer known as Makr managed to run iOS 16 on a Xiaomi Redmi Note 12 4G, a phone originally designed for Android.
The project, called ios-topaz, successfully boots iOS 16 and supports touchscreen controls and physical buttons.
However, it's still experimental. Features like Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, mobile connectivity, cameras, and audio don't fully work yet.
